Container.Name: cabin
Container.Overview:
cabin is an all-in-one internal certificate authority in a single container: a web UI, a REST API (/api/v1 with OpenAPI docs), an ACME v2 server (http-01, dns-01, tls-alpn-01, External Account Binding), an MCP server for AI assistants, direct certificate issuance, CSR signing, PKCS#12 export, a CRL and an audit log.
Everything is configured in the web UI — on first start it asks for an admin account and then walks you through creating (or importing) the CA.
Private keys are encrypted at rest with a master key kept in /data/secret.key. BACK UP THE APPDATA FOLDER: without secret.key the database is useless.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the web UI, the REST API, ACME and MCP.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds cabin.db and secret.key. BACK THIS UP — secret.key encrypts every private key in the database, and without it they are unrecoverable.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true to send session cookies only over HTTPS. Turn this on once cabin sits behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

Config.Name: CABIN_MASTER_PASSPHRASE
Config.Description: Optional passphrase that wraps the master key in secret.key. Set it before the first start — adding or changing it later needs a fresh secret.key and loses every sealed private key.
